import sys

MOD = 1000000007

class Modular:
    def __init__(self, val=0):
        if isinstance(val, Modular):
            self.val = val.val
        else:
            self.val = val % MOD
            if self.val < 0:
                self.val += MOD

    def __neg__(self):
        return Modular(-self.val)

    def __add__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, int):
            other = Modular(other)
        res = self.val + other.val
        if res >= MOD:
            res -= MOD
        return Modular(res)

    def __sub__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, int):
            other = Modular(other)
        res = self.val - other.val
        if res < 0:
            res += MOD
        return Modular(res)

    def __mul__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, int):
            other = Modular(other)
        # Use Python's big integers, then mod
        res = (self.val * other.val) % MOD
        return Modular(res)

    def __truediv__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, int):
            other = Modular(other)
        return self * other.inv()

    def __iadd__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, int):
            other = Modular(other)
        self.val += other.val
        if self.val >= MOD:
            self.val -= MOD
        return self

    def __isub__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, int):
            other = Modular(other)
        self.val -= other.val
        if self.val < 0:
            self.val += MOD
        return self

    def __imul__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, int):
            other = Modular(other)
        self.val = (self.val * other.val) % MOD
        return self

    def __idiv__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, int):
            other = Modular(other)
        return self.__imul__(other.inv())

    def __eq__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, int):
            other = Modular(other)
        return self.val == other.val

    def __ne__(self, other):
        return not self.__eq__(other)

    def __lt__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, int):
            other = Modular(other)
        return self.val < other.val

    def __gt__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, int):
            other = Modular(other)
        return self.val > other.val

    def __le__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, int):
            other = Modular(other)
        return self.val <= other.val

    def __ge__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, int):
            other = Modular(other)
        return self.val >= other.val

    def __int__(self):
        return self.val

    def __repr__(self):
        return str(self.val)

    def pow(self, p):
        a = Modular(self.val)
        ans = Modular(1)
        while p:
            if p & 1:
                ans *= a
            a *= a
            p >>= 1
        return ans

    def inv(self):
        # Extended Euclidean algorithm
        a = self.val
        b = MOD
        ax, bx = 1, 0
        while b:
            q = a // b
            t = a % b
            a, b = b, t
            t = ax - bx * q
            ax, bx = bx, t
        # a should be 1
        if ax < 0:
            ax += MOD
        return Modular(ax)

class Solution:
    def __init__(self, n, inp):
        self.n = n
        self.mid = n // 2
        self.prob = [Modular(0)] * (n * n)
        for i in range(n * n):
            x = int(inp.readline())
            self.prob[i] = Modular(1) / 100 * x
        # idxOfMask: map mask (0..63) to index if popcount == mid else -1
        self.idxOfMask = [-1] * (1 << 6)
        cnt = 0
        for mask in range(1 << 6):
            if bin(mask).count('1') == self.mid:
                self.idxOfMask[mask] = cnt
                cnt += 1
        self.total = [Modular(0)] * (1 << cnt)

    def process(self, L, R, callback):
        length = R - L
        # iterate over all edge masks (length * n bits)
        for edge in range(1 << (length * self.n)):
            p = Modular(1)
            pos = L * self.n
            tmp = edge
            skip_flag = False
            for _ in range(length * self.n):
                if tmp & 1:
                    p *= self.prob[pos]
                else:
                    p *= (Modular(1) - self.prob[pos])
                if p == 0:
                    skip_flag = True
                    break
                tmp >>= 1
                pos += 1
            if skip_flag:
                continue
            # enumerate all data assignments (length elements from 0..n-1)
            data = [0] * length
            go = True
            while go:
                mm = 0
                ok = True
                for i in range(length):
                    bit_pos = i * self.n + data[i]
                    if ((edge >> bit_pos) & 1) == 0:
                        ok = False
                        break
                    if mm & (1 << data[i]):
                        ok = False
                        break
                    mm |= (1 << data[i])
                if ok:
                    if R == self.n:
                        mm ^= (1 << self.n) - 1
                    callback(1 << self.idxOfMask[mm], p)
                # increment data
                i = length - 1
                while i >= 0:
                    if data[i] < self.n - 1:
                        data[i] += 1
                        break
                    else:
                        data[i] = 0
                        i -= 1
                if i < 0:
                    go = False

    def run(self):
        # first half
        def add_total(s, p):
            self.total[s] += p
        self.process(0, self.mid, add_total)
        # subset sum over total
        size = len(self.total)
        d = 1
        while d < size:
            for i in range(size):
                if (i & d) == 0:
                    self.total[i | d] += self.total[i]
            d <<= 1
        ans = Modular(0)
        def add_ans(s, p):
            nonlocal ans
            ans += p * (self.total[-1] - self.total[size - 1 - s])
        self.process(self.mid, self.n, add_ans)
        print(int(ans))

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    sol = Solution(n, it)
    sol.run()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
